```{r setup}
library(NeuRalNetwoRk)
library("bench")
library("nnet")
library("rchallenge")
data("german", package = "rchallenge")
```

```{r benchmarking, results=FALSE}
indices=seq_len(nrow(german))

train=sample(indices, 0.8*nrow(german))
test=indices[-train]

X_train=as.matrix(german[train,c("duration", "amount", "age")])
X_test=as.matrix(german[test,c("duration", "amount", "age")])

Y_train=as.matrix(ifelse(german[train, "credit_risk"]=="good",1,0))
Y_test=as.matrix(ifelse(german[test, "credit_risk"]=="good",1,0))



set.seed(123)

layer_sizes <- c(ncol(X_train), 16, 1)

benchmark_train <- function() {
  set.seed(123)

  network <- initialize_network(layer_sizes)

  train(
    network,
    X_train,
    Y_train,
    epochs = 500,
    mini_batch_size = 32,
    learning_rate = 0.01
  )
}

benchmark_train()
benchmark_nnet <- function() {
  set.seed(123)

  nnet::nnet(
    x = X_train,
    y = Y_train,
    size = 16,
    linout = FALSE,
    entropy = FALSE,
    decay = 0,
    maxit = 500,
    trace = FALSE,
    MaxNWts = 10000
  )
}

results <- bench::mark(
  NeuRalNetwoRk = benchmark_train(),
  nnet=benchmark_nnet(),
  iterations = 3,
  check = FALSE,
  memory = TRUE
)

print(results)
```

To initialize and train your network: 
```{r train_network}

network=initialize_network(layer_sizes)
trained_network=train(network, X_train, Y_train, mini_batch_size = 32, learning_rate=0.01)

```

To use your trained network for prediction:
```{r predictions}
raw_predictions=t(feedforward(trained_network, X_test))
binary_predictions=ifelse(raw_predictions>=0.5,1,0)
print(sum(binary_predictions==Y_test)/length(Y_test))
```
